name: Xero
description: Xero is cloud-based accounting software for small businesses, covering invoicing, bank reconciliation, expense claims, and financial reporting, built with unlimited users on every plan and designed for close, real-time collaboration between a business and its accountant or bookkeeper.
best_for: Small businesses that want lower-cost accounting software with unlimited user seats and work closely with an accountant or bookkeeper who already uses Xero.

tiers.name: Early
tiers.notes: Send 20 invoices and enter 5 bills per month; reconcile bank transactions.

tiers.name: Growing
tiers.notes: Unlimited invoices and bills; bulk transaction reconciliation.

tiers.name: Established
tiers.notes: Adds multi-currency, expense claims, and project tracking.

pros: Unlimited users on every plan, unlike per-seat competitors
Lower list price than QuickBooks Online at each comparable tier
Real-time bank reconciliation UX that accountants frequently cite as a strength
cons: Smaller US bookkeeper/accountant familiarity than QuickBooks, which can matter when hiring outside help
Entry-level Early plan caps monthly invoice and bill volume, unlike QuickBooks' uncapped Simple Start
US-specific payroll support is more limited than QuickBooks' native payroll add-on

faq.question: Does Xero charge per user?
faq.answer: No — every Xero plan includes unlimited users at no extra cost, which is a real structural difference from QuickBooks Online, where higher tiers cap the number of users.

faq.question: Is Xero cheaper than QuickBooks Online?
faq.answer: At official list prices, yes — Xero's three tiers ($25/$55/$90 per month) each undercut QuickBooks Online's comparable tiers, though QuickBooks' Simple Start plan has no invoice/bill volume cap, which Xero's entry-level Early plan does.

alternatives.name: QuickBooks Online
alternatives.description: Intuit cloud accounting software with the widest US bookkeeper and accountant ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Small businesses that want the accounting software most US bookkeepers already know how to use

alternatives.name: FreshBooks
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting and invoicing software with built-in time tracking and client estimate workflows.
alternatives.best_for: Freelancers and consultants needing simple client billing and project profitability

alternatives.name: Wave
alternatives.description: Free cloud accounting and invoicing software designed for solopreneurs and micro-businesses.
alternatives.best_for: Solopreneurs seeking zero-subscription invoicing and basic double-entry bookkeeping

alternatives.name: Zoho Books
alternatives.description: Cloud accounting software that automates core financial workflows, handles multi-currency invoicing, manages inventory, and integrates with the wider Zoho ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Small to mid-sized businesses and existing Zoho users wanting workflow automation and cost-effective multi-user accounting
